adjudication.rationale: The diff updates the `Calendar` interface so `createEvent` must accept `(event: CalendarEvent, credentialId: number)` (packages/types/Calendar.d.ts) and `CalendarManager.createEvent` now calls `calendar.createEvent(calEvent, credential.id)` (packages/core/CalendarManager.ts). However, non-Google implementations shown in the diff (e.g., `packages/app-store/larkcalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`) still define `async createEvent(event: CalendarEvent)` and select the calendar via the first element (`const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? []; const calendarId = mainHostDestinationCalendar?.externalId;`), not by the passed credential id. Similarly, the CalDAV-based `packages/lib/CalendarService.ts` logic continues to key off the first destination calendar’s `externalId`. With `destinationCalendar` now an array and `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents` potentially creating events for multiple destinations/credentials, these services can write to the wrong calendar (and also violate the updated interface contract).
